en: Sepia-toned postcard showing a wide seaside promenade and beach with sunbeds and parasols, a pier stretching into the sea, and a line of grand buildings along the waterfront. Hills or low mountains rise in the background. On the lower left are Greek postage stamps, one with an airmail overprint and airplane illustration. The bottom caption identifies the scene as N. Phalère (New Phaleron) beach, with bilingual Greek and French text.
